source_snapshot.procedure: Uses fixed fabric tuple with pcieerror errortype2 TX and 3 RX and mandates immediate reset after each.
source_snapshot.criteria: Calls the events correctable and expects tool PASS/OS report despite both resets.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; live broad logs cannot bridge reset or distinguish direction.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Preserves two reset cycles but lacks flag authority, severity decision and durable oracle.

old_problem: Correctable criteria conflict with mandatory immediate resets, proprietary errortype2/3 direction and command-family semantics are unproven, and post-boot dmesg cannot establish the pre-reset ECRC source.
disposition_reason: Neither PCIe standards nor ED-18 resolves why a purported correctable ECRC must reset or what this AMD command's errortype2/3 means. The conflict changes expected behavior, PASS/FAIL and recovery, so it is not a parameter-only gap. ED-03/12/16 prohibit inferring the flags, forcing reset or executing two cycles without durable evidence and an approved boot recovery matrix. Pending/BLOCKED is retained.
decision_basis: Read Reliability row63, same-row AI, historical record2464, related flag usages and next OCP ECRC row64.
Preserved every PCIe slot, TX and RX, and two independent reset-cycle requirements.
Required complete recovery/evidence closure after TX before RX authorization.
Required durable BMC/UEFI/OOB source evidence rather than volatile post-boot logs.
No BIOS/HDT change, ECRC injection, reset, retry or DUT test occurred.

test_case.purpose: For every approved PCIe slot, validate authoritative TX and RX ECRC stimuli as separate cycles through the signed severity/reset branch, durable source evidence, reboot and link/device recovery.
required_package: Vendor pcieerror errortype2/3 direction and command-family contract
Decoded AER/DPC/SyncFlood policy and durable evidence path
Independent OOB boot/reimage and link/device restoration runbook
test_case.test_command: Do not run the source commands or force reset. After authority is published, baseline durable state and execute one mapped TX stimulus once; capture source and reset/boot recovery, close all evidence and restore the NIC/link; only then independently authorize the RX cycle using the same controls.
test_case.expected_result: Each direction produces the exact approved ECRC source/severity and containment/reset response, durable evidence survives reboot, and firmware, OS, NIC, driver and link recover within deadlines with restored configuration before the next cycle.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS until flag, severity and reset semantics are authoritative. Tool PASS, post-boot generic logs, wrong direction/source, unexpected or missing reset, lost evidence, incomplete first-cycle recovery, boot loop or degraded link fails.
safety_gate: Dedicated backed-up SUT with independent BMC/console and reimage path.
Exclude boot/management-critical NICs and quiesce traffic.
One direction once; RX forbidden until TX recovery is signed off.
No automatic retry/reset; preserve crash evidence.
expected_evidence: TX durable ECRC/reset/boot record and recovery closure
RX durable ECRC/reset/boot record and recovery closure
test_case.recovery: Define both expected and unexpected reset branches, boot-loop/reimage escape and exact NIC/link/AER/BIOS/HDT restoration. Execution remains blocked until the recovery owner approves both cycles.
